name: 花卉租赁审批操作链路钻取 V2.2.3
description: 适配 DTS v2.2.3；内部。依据花卉 V2 模型及已登记 ODS 日志；空金额保留为空，不将未知值视为零。

components.name: PRS 审批操作链路钻取

config.text: PRS 审批操作链路钻取

sqlConfig.query: SELECT DISTINCT project_name::text AS label, project_name::text AS value FROM (SELECT l.id,l.biz_id AS order_id,l.sorts,l.operation_title AS operation_kind,l.operation_user_id,l.operation_user_name,l.operation_time,l.operation_content,o.order_code,o.project_name,o.customer_name,o.type_name,o.status_name,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (l.operation_time-LAG(l.operation_time) OVER (PARTITION BY l.biz_id ORDER BY l.operation_time,l.sorts,l.id)))/86400 AS step_days FROM public.ods_prst_flower_biz_log l JOIN (SELECT o.*,c.customer_name,CASE o.order_type WHEN 1 THEN '换花' WHEN 2 THEN '加花' WHEN 3 THEN '减花' WHEN 4 THEN '调花' WHEN 6 THEN '坏账' WHEN 7 THEN '售花' WHEN 8 THEN '赠花' WHEN 10 THEN '辅料' WHEN 11 THEN '加盆架' WHEN 12 THEN '减盆架' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,CASE o.order_status WHEN -1 THEN '已作废' WHEN 1 THEN '审核中' WHEN 2 THEN '备货中' WHEN 3 THEN '核算中' WHEN 4 THEN '待结算' WHEN 5 THEN '已结束' WHEN 20 THEN '草稿' WHEN 21 THEN '驳回' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name FROM public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id WHERE o.is_effective) o ON o.order_id=l.biz_id) options WHERE project_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY label

SELECT DISTINCT operation_kind::text AS label, operation_kind::text AS value FROM (SELECT l.id,l.biz_id AS order_id,l.sorts,l.operation_title AS operation_kind,l.operation_user_id,l.operation_user_name,l.operation_time,l.operation_content,o.order_code,o.project_name,o.customer_name,o.type_name,o.status_name,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (l.operation_time-LAG(l.operation_time) OVER (PARTITION BY l.biz_id ORDER BY l.operation_time,l.sorts,l.id)))/86400 AS step_days FROM public.ods_prst_flower_biz_log l JOIN (SELECT o.*,c.customer_name,CASE o.order_type WHEN 1 THEN '换花' WHEN 2 THEN '加花' WHEN 3 THEN '减花' WHEN 4 THEN '调花' WHEN 6 THEN '坏账' WHEN 7 THEN '售花' WHEN 8 THEN '赠花' WHEN 10 THEN '辅料' WHEN 11 THEN '加盆架' WHEN 12 THEN '减盆架' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,CASE o.order_status WHEN -1 THEN '已作废' WHEN 1 THEN '审核中' WHEN 2 THEN '备货中' WHEN 3 THEN '核算中' WHEN 4 THEN '待结算' WHEN 5 THEN '已结束' WHEN 20 THEN '草稿' WHEN 21 THEN '驳回' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name FROM public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id WHERE o.is_effective) o ON o.order_id=l.biz_id) options WHERE operation_kind IS NOT NULL ORDER BY label

WITH b AS (SELECT l.id,l.biz_id AS order_id,l.sorts,l.operation_title AS operation_kind,l.operation_user_id,l.operation_user_name,l.operation_time,l.operation_content,o.order_code,o.project_name,o.customer_name,o.type_name,o.status_name,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (l.operation_time-LAG(l.operation_time) OVER (PARTITION BY l.biz_id ORDER BY l.operation_time,l.sorts,l.id)))/86400 AS step_days FROM public.ods_prst_flower_biz_log l JOIN (SELECT o.*,c.customer_name,CASE o.order_type WHEN 1 THEN '换花' WHEN 2 THEN '加花' WHEN 3 THEN '减花' WHEN 4 THEN '调花' WHEN 6 THEN '坏账' WHEN 7 THEN '售花' WHEN 8 THEN '赠花' WHEN 10 THEN '辅料' WHEN 11 THEN '加盆架' WHEN 12 THEN '减盆架' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,CASE o.order_status WHEN -1 THEN '已作废' WHEN 1 THEN '审核中' WHEN 2 THEN '备货中' WHEN 3 THEN '核算中' WHEN 4 THEN '待结算' WHEN 5 THEN '已结束' WHEN 20 THEN '草稿' WHEN 21 THEN '驳回' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name FROM public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id WHERE o.is_effective) o ON o.order_id=l.biz_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "日志数", COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS "单据数", COUNT(DISTINCT operation_user_id) AS "操作人数", ROUND(AVG(step_days) FILTER (WHERE step_days>=0)::numeric,2) AS "平均步骤天数" FROM b WHERE operation_time >= {{dateFrom}}::date AND operation_time < ({{dateTo}}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') [[AND project_name = {{projectName}}]] [[AND operation_kind = {{operationKind}}]]
